ideas.title: Investigating Fraud in Government Programs
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of fraud in government programs and the measures being taken to prevent it
questions: What is the extent of fraud in government programs?
What measures are being taken to prevent fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant waste and corruption in government programs. By following the money and analyzing data, we can identify areas where fraud is most likely to occur and highlight the need for increased oversight and regulation.
